title: Tilt Check
briefing: Nimbus Cloud is jumpy this month, and an early loss is likely. The test is what you do next.
objective: Avoid revenge trading: after a loss, keep size and rules the same and wait for a real setup.
debrief: Nimbus Cloud jumped on the reseller deal on day 3, then gapped down when the deal was put on hold on day 5, handing early buyers a quick loss. The next two weeks were choppy, and traders trying to win it back paid fees and took more losses. From day 18 a clean uptrend followed the new product launch. A disciplined player kept losses small, did not double up, and waited for the real trend.
